title: PICasso：AI驱动的硅光子器件自动优化设计框架
summary: PICasso是一个AI辅助框架，可从自然语言规范自动合成、验证和优化光子集成电路。它结合NL->YAML->GDS流程、PDK知识注入、自动布局布线、DRC/LVS验证和SAX仿真。引入PIC-Set基准测试36个设计任务，相比纯LLM生成，结构Spec@3达92.7%，功能Spec@3达52%，插入损耗平均降低1.74dB。
summary_en: PICasso is an AI-assisted framework for automated synthesis, verification, and optimization of photonic integrated circuits from natural-language specifications. It introduces PIC-Set benchmark and improves structural Spec@3 to 92.7% and functional Spec@3 to 52%, reducing insertion loss by 1.74 dB.
